text.title: Architect Skill Index (Geek Tier) Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Is the requested deliverable an index over existing, active methodologies (no new methodology bodies to be written)?

branch.conclusion: Skip. Authoring a new methodology is a different job; write it under its own slug first, then index it.

branch.question: Does every entry's wikilink resolve to a directory whose `meta.json` has `status: active`, with each slug appearing once?

branch.conclusion: Run the resolver, re-point or remove every failing or duplicated entry, then re-enter the tree.

branch.question: Does every entry carry an architect-perspective `architect_why` that is not the target's summary, and are clusters named by architecture activity rather than by tool?

branch.conclusion: Rewrite each copied or missing sentence to name the architecture task the entry serves; reject entries where no task can be named.
Re-cluster by activity (elicit, decide and record, document views, evaluate and review, govern drift) and merge clusters with fewer than three entries.
Run the full procedure: fixed entry fields, 50 distinct targets or an honest gap list, uncovered-tasks section, relink script scheduled; emit the index per the output contract.

example.p: Deliverable is an index over sdlc-ai entries: index over existing. Resolver finds 52 of 54 slugs active, two renamed → conclusion r-entry-resolves-to-existing-slug; after re-pointing, clusters are named "spec-kit" and "plan-mode" → r-clustered-by-architecture-activity on the next pass.
